pages.text: Conflict and harm, weapons of violence. The bloodied banner of victory at any cost. Cycles of victimization and vengeance.$(br2)Every point of damage dealt by a war-hallowed weapon will put a War spirit in that weapon.

When a player or bound/tamed mob deals damage in range of a war shrine, the shrine will try to spend spirits equal to thrice the damage. This will double the damage taken. The effects of multiple shrines stack.$(br2)War spirits are also the fuel for Spawn Altars.
